<thought>Based on the high‑resolution ESI‑MS data, the protonated ion appears at m/z 262.0994. Subtracting the mass of a proton gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈261.092 Da. The formula that matches this mass most closely (error ≈ 5 mDa, ~20 ppm) and is consistent with the observed isotopic pattern is C₁₃H₁₃N₂O₄. This fits the required output format CxHyOzX (where “X” includes the nitrogen atoms).</thought>
<final_answer>C13H13N2O4</final_answer>
